_comment: UWG demo template: a local stdio server on an isolated copy of the store, with the demo's 3 tools and look (AICESAT_PROFILE=demo). Replace the <...> placeholders, merge into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude Desktop. AICESAT_PORT 8792 keeps it off a normal server (8765) and a test server (8791); Open in 3D opens it.
